originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/failed-search: Ellzey arXiv:1709.00454 proves F-expansion for all digraphs, p-positivity in symmetric case, symmetry for circular-indifference digraphs, and e-formula ONLY for directed cycle C_n^-> (Thm 6.1/Cor 6.2), conjecturing the circular-indifference generalization (Conj 1.4); k>=2 powers outside proved e-cases. F/p data do not imply e-signs due to Kostka-type cancellations in F->e and p->e transitions. Alexandersson-Panova (1705.10353) proves e-coefficient interpretations only for line/cycle graphs, no k>=2 power vector. White (2106.02665) proves F-positivity for class functions, no power e-vector. Aval-Melgar (2508.20200) is SQSym structural theory with no power e-result. Undirected theorems (Hikita, Griffin et al., Tom, Lee, Cho-Huh) cover only natural unit-interval graphs and do not imply digraph e-signs. Live arXiv API checks on 2026-09-09: query 'circular indifference digraph' returns only Ellzey (totalResults 1); query chromatic-quasisymmetric AND e-positivity returns 12 hits all on undirected/LLT/Smirnov settings, none logging any e-coefficient of C_{8,2}; Aval-Melgar query returns only 2508.20200. No database or preprint logs the C_{8,2} e-vector; it is not a substitution into an existing e-formula since none exists for k>=2. Originality failure is therefore not present.

value.rationale: PRESET_FALLBACK with exact completion: Admission granted conditional value approval for this exact fallback (first complete e-positivity certificate beyond the directed cycle, binary replay test, retrievable as C_{n,2} induction base case and SQSym benchmark). Per route policy, value is not re-litigated merely because the result is narrower than the infinite C_{n,k} target. No ADMISSION_DEFECT: objective evidence confirms the qualification was materially true — no prior source records any e-coefficient of C_{8,2}, no general k>=2 e-formula exists, F/p tables do not mechanically imply e-signs, and the object/invariant were motivated before computation (smallest circular power beyond settled k=1; Ellzey Conj 1.4 e-positivity). The datum independently satisfies the finite-exact-invariant standard: natural object + motivated invariant, value not known or implied, precise fact a future researcher could retrieve (base case, peak-center tests, signed/SQSym benchmark). Hence value PASS under the presumption, and also on its own terms.
